info.title: Workeasy Forms API
info.description: Routes implemented through RUN-02. Organization routes derive the tenant from the authenticated membership; resources outside the caller's organizations return 404. Every response carries an X-Request-Id header, and every error is application/problem+json with the same requestId.

get.summary: A published form's live version, for rendering (respondents answer through a session)
get.description: Anyone-with-the-link forms: Cache-Control public, max-age=30. Organization-only forms need the respondent sign-in and are private, no-store. Unknown, draft, archived and deleted forms are all 404.

401.description: SIGN_IN_REQUIRED: organization-only form; sign in at signInUrl

post.summary: Start a respondent session pinned to the live version (respondent origin only)
post.description: Organization-only forms need a respondent sign-in and an active membership. The capability is returned once; only its hash is stored. Sessions last two hours and keep their version even if a newer one is published.

401.description: SIGN_IN_REQUIRED: sign in at signInUrl (organization-only forms)

get.summary: Whether this session may submit right now (never cached)
get.description: Reads the current form state and access policy, so closing a form or revoking a member takes effect immediately.

200.description: Accepting, with the session's pinned version

401.description: SESSION_INVALID: missing, forged, expired or another session's capability

403.description: NOT_A_MEMBER: the respondent no longer has access

404.description: The form is no longer available

post.description: The response, its idempotency record, the session's accepted marker and a submission.accepted.v1 event commit together, after the form's state and the respondent's access are rechecked under a lock and the answers pass the server engine. A session accepts one response. Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key and content returns the recorded receipt (Idempotent-Replayed: true); a later request under another key gets the first receipt (Submission-Already-Accepted: true). Answers are never echoed back.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 8 to 200 visible ASCII characters; reuse it when retrying the same answers

201.description: Accepted (or a replay of the same request, with Idempotent-Replayed: true)

403.description: NOT_A_MEMBER: the respondent no longer has access

404.description: The form is no longer available

409.description: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (same key, different answers) or VERSION_MISMATCH (not the session's version)

422.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: field errors from the engine, as answers.<fieldId>
